categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Tanac Precision Machinery Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the intelligent equipment manufacturing industry, providing customized intelligent manufacturing comprehensive solutions. Its main business segments include standard machines (standardized winding machines for electronic coils), non-standard machines (customized winding machines and integrated intelligent production lines), and special machines (customized intelligent equipment and production lines beyond winding functions). The company serves downstream industries such as consumer electronics, automotive, and industrial control.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including high-precision tension control, wire arrangement control, and high-speed spindle systems for winding machines. It integrates multiple processes such as automatic loading/unloading, winding, soldering, terminal insertion, coating, testing, and data uploading into intelligent production lines. The company also has strong capabilities in high-precision component processing using CNC machine tools, wire cutting, and grinding equipment, supporting its product innovation and manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are from consumer electronics, automotive, and industrial control sectors. In consumer electronics, the company supplies equipment for wireless charging coils, high-frequency heating coils, and camera motor coils. In automotive, it serves traditional motor businesses and new energy vehicle sectors with products like SMD transformer winding equipment and laser radar production lines. Industrial control customers include servo motor stator and rotor production lines. The company maintains long-term stable relationships with over a thousand customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Zhejiang Province and branches in Shenzhen, Shanghai, and Hangzhou. It also has subsidiaries in Japan and Malaysia. Its sales are mainly domestic (about 76.75% of revenue) with growing export sales (23.25%), including markets in India, South Korea, and other Asian countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Tanac Precision Machinery operates mainly in the midstream of the supply chain as a manufacturer and integrator of intelligent manufacturing equipment and production lines. It designs, develops, and produces customized intelligent equipment and solutions for downstream manufacturers in electronics, automotive, and industrial control industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on maintaining technological leadership through continuous R&D investment, emphasizing high-end, intelligent, and integrated manufacturing solutions. Key R&D projects include intelligent integrated production equipment for inductors, smart assembly and testing lines for automotive motors and laser radar modules, next-generation wireless charging equipment, and advanced winding machines with proprietary control systems. It also pursues digitalization and automation to improve production efficiency and product quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of intelligent manufacturing equipment and customized production lines. The company signs contracts directly with customers and delivers products accordingly. It also earns income from providing after-sales services and maintenance. A small portion of sales is conducted via agency sales in overseas markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic provider of customized intelligent manufacturing solutions with a strong brand heritage originating from Japan Tanac Seiki. It holds a leading market share in the wireless charging coil manufacturing equipment segment and maintains competitive advantages through advanced technology, comprehensive solutions, and stable customer relationships. Competitors include other intelligent equipment manufacturers in China and internationally, but the company emphasizes its integrated solutions and technological innovation to differentiate itself.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 226 million, a 13% decrease from the previous year. It experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 153.55 million, reflecting significant challenges including impairment losses and subsidiary performance issues. Despite the downturn, the company continues to invest in R&D (about 9.9% of revenue) and pursues strategic growth through innovation and market expansion. The company has total assets of approximately RMB 884 million and equity attributable to shareholders of about RMB 523 million.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Tanac Precision Machinery emphasizes its unique value proposition as a provider of highly customized, integrated intelligent manufacturing solutions that enhance production efficiency, product quality, and automation. Its products feature proprietary technologies such as intelligent tension control and embedded control systems, enabling high precision and stability. The company offers one-stop solutions from single intelligent equipment to full production lines, supported by strong R&D capabilities and comprehensive after-sales services, catering to diverse and evolving customer needs in high-growth sectors.
